title: KCF Source Coverage Report v1
description: Bidirectional traceability between validated prose and the extracted model: prose that produced no construct (missed extraction) and constructs grounded in no prose (ungrounded additions), plus dangling-trace integrity.

uncoveredSegments.description: Segments that produced no construct - potential missed extraction.

unsourcedConstructs.description: Constructs citing no segment - potential ungrounded additions.

danglingSegments.description: Trace segmentIds not present in the source document.

danglingConstructs.description: Trace construct identities not present in the model.

sourceComplete.description: Linkage is complete: nothing dropped, nothing invented, no dangling links.

sourceConfirmed.description: Stronger than source-complete: every sourced construct's encoding has been reviewed (encoding-reviewed or semantically-confirmed) and none is disputed/superseded.

reviewStates.description: Count of sourced constructs by their (best) encoding-review state.

unconfirmedConstructs.description: Sourced constructs whose encoding has not been (governed-)confirmed.

disputedConstructs.description: Sourced constructs whose encoding is disputed or superseded.

ungovernedConfirmations.description: Records that CLAIM a confirmed review state but fail governance (missing reviewer/time/disposition/version, excerpt-hash mismatch, or the construct is not in the referenced link). Surfaced, never silently accepted - a fabricated confirmation is caught here.
